scene.setting: a curving sandstone-paved road lined with orange-leaved autumn trees, low stone walls and street lamps
scene.lighting: Bright clear afternoon sunlight casts soft shadows across the paving

character.subject: protagonist
character.look: a young dark-haired man in a dark red leather coat with a crimson hood

melee_attack.name: Flame Fist
melee_attack.text: swings a fist wreathed in flame that bursts against {target}

ranged_attack.name: Fireball
ranged_attack.text: raises his right hand and hurls a fireball that bursts into flames on {target}

dash.name: Ember Dash
dash.text: dashes forward in a streak of embers that scorch the ground behind him

entities.cultist: the hooded cultist in a black robe

take.action: walks down the road away from the camera, turns side-on and raises his right arm toward the opponent, then {skill:ranged_attack}; the cultist is hit and collapses onto the road and stays down
take.camera: The camera follows from behind as the road bends to the right.
